template.p: This task is yours. Read it, then drag it to Done: that is the whole workflow.
template.h3: What makes it different from Odoo's To-Do

ul.li: Stages are shared. A stage belongs to the task, not to whoever is looking at it. When you move a card to In Progress, it is in progress for everybody.
One owner per task. Every task has exactly one assignee. Reassigning it takes it away from the previous owner.
Users see their own tasks; administrators see all of them. You are an administrator.
My Tasks: your board, grouped by stage. Drag cards between columns.
By Person: every task of the team grouped by owner. Only administrators see this menu.
Configuration > Stages: rename, reorder or add stages. Tick Closing Stage so its tasks count as done, and Folded in Kanban to collapse the column.

Configuration > Users & Roles: open a user, tab Access Rights, section Team To-Do, and pick User or Administrator. Every internal user is a User already; the Odoo administrators became Team To-Do administrators on install.
The deadline turns red when overdue and orange when it is due today.
The star marks an important task.
Done tasks are struck through, and the Done column is folded by default.
